panel.label: Rig
panel.name: rig_panel

button.label: Switch to IK
button.name: ik_on_btn
button.tool_tip: From this frame the limb follows its IK target, with no jump

button.label: Switch to FK
button.name: ik_off_btn
button.tool_tip: From this frame the limb follows its joint rotations, with no jump

button.label: Key IK from Avatar
button.name: ik_key_btn
button.tool_tip: Place hands and feet with the Poser, then key the IK targets and poles of every limb in IK here

panel.text: Hold and Bind (the joints selected in the Animator)

button.label: Hold in World
button.name: hold_btn
button.tool_tip: Keep the selected joints where they are in the world from this frame on

button.label: Release from Here
button.name: release_btn
button.tool_tip: End the hold or bind of the selected joints at this frame

button.label: Delete Pin
button.name: delete_pin_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the whole hold or bind the selected joints have at this frame

button.label: Bind to
button.name: bind_btn
button.tool_tip: The selected joints follow this bone from this frame on

check_box.label: Mirrored
check_box.name: mirror_check
check_box.tool_tip: Hand shapes are left-hand; mirrored puts them on the right
